description: Holds cms credit note requisition records, linked to branch, branch closing reasons, cms credit note types.
business_purpose: Used to track and report cms credit note requisition records, including approval status, amounts and quantities, for the Accounts & Finance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: code
columns.description: Code reference of the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: message
columns.description: Free-text message for the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: creditnote_typeid
columns.description: Reference to the cms credit note types linked to this cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: branchid
columns.description: Reference to the branch linked to this cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: is_approved
columns.description: True when the cms credit note requisition is approved.

columns.name: is_rejected
columns.description: True when the cms credit note requisition is rejected.

columns.name: operated_date
columns.description: Date and time of operated.

columns.name: operated_byId
columns.description: User who approved or rejected the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: file
columns.description: File (file or link reference) for the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: JVCNRorBranchTransfer
columns.description: JVCN ror branch transfer of the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: is_closed
columns.description: True when the cms credit note requisition is closed.

columns.name: creditnote_type
columns.description: Creditnote type of the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: branch_closing_reasonid
columns.description: Reference to the branch closing reasons linked to this cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: remarks
columns.description: Free-text remarks for the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: Vendor_name
columns.description: Name of the vendor.

columns.name: Amount
columns.description: Amount of the cms credit note requisition.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Title of the cms credit note requisition.

relationships.description: Each cms credit note requisition references one cms credit note types (creditnote type).
User who created the cms credit note requisition.
Each cms credit note requisition references one branch (branch).
User who last modified the cms credit note requisition.
User who approved or rejected the cms credit note requisition.
Each cms credit note requisition references one branch closing reasons (branch closing reason).
Each cms credit note requisition can have many branch cnr remarks records referencing it through requisitionid.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
Approval state is tracked with is_approved, is_rejected; a record with neither flag set is typically still pending.
is_closed = 1 marks the record as closed.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use Amount for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns creditnote_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch, Branch Closing Reasons, CMS Credit Note Types through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

known_issues: Amount is stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
Amount is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name CMS_CreditNoteRequisition (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting cms credit note requisition records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(Amount) for totals of amount.
To resolve names, join on: creditnote_typeid = CMS_CreditNoteTypes.id; branchid = Branch.id; branch_closing_reasonid = BranchClosingReasons.id.
Do not select file; they are sensitive or may hold very large content.
